name: startup-warm
description: The same measurement as `startup`, taken on the second launch of a repository rather than the first. rgitui hydrates the commit list from a persistent history cache before the first refresh runs, so this is the start almost every real launch is — and the only one that shows whether that cache is earning its keep. Run it after `startup`, which is what leaves the cache it needs; run on its own against an empty state directory it is a cold start wearing the wrong name.
